title: Age-amplified high AST/ALT ratio does not establish added grip-strength prediction across two NHANES samples
abstract: A fixed older-age by high-AST/ALT interaction was tested beyond nonlinear enzyme and ratio main effects, age, body size and routine chemistry. NHANES2011-12 development n=4023; separate2013-14 external sample n=4549. External weighted MSE reduction0.015920kg² (0.01171%); joint source-refit/target rescaled-PSU bootstrap95% interval[-0.446962,0.633528]. Development CV gain did not establish external added prediction, with sensitivity sign changes. Both cycles were used for previous questions: this is question-specific external evaluation, not globally untouched confirmation or independent clinical-program validation.
